 Where To Find Bigfoot In GTA 6
 The Grand Theft Auto series is rife with easter eggs, and perhaps none are more famous than the Sasquatch, or as more commonly referred to as Big Foot. It’s appeared in previous GTA titles, but would you believe it, it’s shown up once again, this time in Grand Theft Auto 6 .
 The best part? You don’t even need to progress far through the game to find it for yourselves! That said, the whole encounter is pretty strange, even for GTA standards.
 So, if you want to find Bigfoot, here’s where to search for it in GTA 6, as well as what happens when you do. 
 You can buy Grand Theft Auto 6 here if you haven’t already!
 Where To Find Bigfoot In GTA 6
 Image by Insider Gaming. 
 If you want to see Bigfoot for yourself, you’ll want to drive to Cottonmouth Lake, just below Hamlet. 
 You don’t need to progress far through the game’s main story to be able to travel here, so as soon as you’re free to drive around, head here if you want to experience one of the first big GTA 6 easter eggs.
 Related: All GTA 6 Cheats—Best Grand Theft Auto 6 Cheat Codes 
 I’ll keep the encounter a secret until further below, in case you want to experience it first-hand for yourselves, but you’ll know that you’re in the right area when you hear a deep, guttural growl—it’s truly hard to miss.
 GTA 6 Bigfoot Encounter
 Image by Insider Gaming. 
 Before long, you’ll run into Bigfoot on the road, standing over an animal corpse. 
 As you approach, it’ll quickly scarper off into the marshlands nearby, but not before you can get a good look at it. You’re free to follow the Sasquatch, though odds are you won’t have much luck, as it soon disappears. However, in its place, you’ll be able to find a strange effigy of sorts tied to a nearby tree.
 Related: GTA 6 Money-Making Guide—Quickest Ways To Earn Money In GTA 6 
 It’s definitely a creepy sight, but what’s worse is that if you stick around, the flowers nearby seem to put you to sleep, triggering a unique cutscene. As you flicker in and out of consciousness, Bigfoot will approach you, though all you’ll see are its large, hairy feet…
 And that’s it! It’s unclear if this is a one-off encounter, or if you can find Bigfoot at other locations and this is the first step in an elaborate easter egg, but for now, it’s a pretty cool moment! If more’s found, we’ll be sure to update the article and keep the GTA 6 Bigfoot chronicles alive.

— LAZAR (@Lazarbeam) November 18, 2026
